name: between-trains
description: A waiting room for agentic development — turn agent-working intervals into short moments for learning, play, or calm.

betweenTrains.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable Between Trains. When disabled, no waiting room is opened.

betweenTrains.autoOpen.enabled.markdownDescription: Automatically open the waiting room when an agent is detected as working. Disabled by default; the MVP is manual-first.

enumDescriptions: Reopen with the mode you used most recently.
betweenTrains.defaultMode.markdownDescription: Which mode to show when a waiting session opens.

betweenTrains.ollama.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the local Ollama server used to generate learning cards.

betweenTrains.ollama.model.markdownDescription: Ollama model to use. Leave blank to auto-select the first model installed on your Ollama server; set a name (e.g. `llama3.2`) to always use that one. Pull models with `ollama pull <model>`.

betweenTrains.ollama.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: How long to wait for an Ollama response before giving up and using a fallback card.

betweenTrains.brain.enabled.markdownDescription: Use the local Ollama brain to generate learning cards. When off, learning modes show curated offline cards.

betweenTrains.brain.provider.markdownDescription: Which local LLM backend the brain uses. More providers (e.g. vLLM, OpenAI-compatible) may be added later. Editable from the waiting room's Global config.

betweenTrains.brain.workspaceContext.ena.markdownDescription: Allow the brain to use small, safe hints from your workspace (e.g. the active file's language). Never sends source code. Disabled by default.

betweenTrains.memes.autoFetch.markdownDescription: When the Memes & GIFs mode opens, let the local agent automatically fetch a fresh batch from Tenor/Giphy. Off by default — fetching makes network requests.

betweenTrains.memes.fetchCount.markdownDescription: How many new GIFs the agent tries to save per fetch.

betweenTrains.videos.autoFetch.markdownDescription: When the Video mode opens, let the local agent automatically fetch a fresh batch of YouTube videos. Off by default — fetching makes network requests.

betweenTrains.videos.fetchCount.markdownDescription: How many new videos the agent tries to save per fetch.

betweenTrains.news.provider.markdownDescription: Which web-search provider the News mode uses. Set the provider's API key from the waiting room's Global config (keys are stored in VS Code SecretStorage, never in settings).

betweenTrains.news.autoFetch.markdownDescription: When a News category opens, let the agent automatically fetch fresh news. Off by default — fetching makes network requests to your chosen search provider.

betweenTrains.news.fetchCount.markdownDescription: How many news cards the agent tries to save per fetch.

betweenTrains.learning.autoFetch.markdownDescription: Automatically generate learning cards for a topic when you open it (respects the auto-fetch cooldown). Off by default.

betweenTrains.learning.cardCount.markdownDescription: How many learning cards the agent tries to generate per topic per run.

betweenTrains.autoFetch.cooldownMinutes.markdownDescription: When a mode's auto-fetch is on, opening it re-fetches only if that content stream hasn't been fetched within this many minutes. Manual fetches always run and reset the timer. Set to `0` to always auto-fetch on open.

betweenTrains.metadata.enabled.markdownDescription: Store local session and interaction metadata on this machine to personalize the experience. Nothing leaves your device.

betweenTrains.metadata.retentionDays.markdownDescription: How many days of raw local session history to keep before it is pruned.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Calm and game modes work in untrusted workspaces. Workspace-context features for learning cards are disabled until the workspace is trusted.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Local-first metadata and Ollama features assume a local extension host; static modes work in virtual workspaces.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
